title: Requires some DIY
text: Requires some DIY. The photo is what I received.  No wire in the arm; I will have to add one to shape it.  Fingers are sewn together and the little ornament has a loop hanger that is not long enough to hand the ornament from the fingers.  I either have to cut the fingers apart and re-sew or cut the loop on the ornament.  I think as long as I am going to all this trouble, I will also attach a different means of attaching it to the tree.  It is cute, but if you don’t have DIY skills I would pass on it.
